<section id="about"><div class="wrap">
<h2>About</h2>
<p>I’m a Computer Science graduate (Arab Open University, 2026) seeking an IT support role. I’m hands-on with Windows and Linux troubleshooting, Active Directory, networking basics, hardware and software setup, and ticket handling.</p>
<p>Because I work across development, analytics and technical support, I understand both how systems are built and how real users run into trouble with them. I explain technical things in plain language, document what I do, and follow a problem through until it is solved.</p>
</div></section>

<div class="card"><span class="tag">Team project</span><h3>Customer 360 Analytics Platform</h3><p>An end-to-end Lakehouse on Databricks that combines CRM, orders, products, support and clickstream data through Bronze, Silver and Gold layers into a model ready for Power BI reporting.</p><div class="chips"><span>Databricks</span><span>PySpark</span><span>SQL</span><span>Power BI</span><span>DAX</span></div></div>

<div class="card"><span class="tag">Team project</span><h3>Global Geographic Analysis</h3><p>Three interactive dashboards comparing population, education, literacy, employment and economic indicators across 195+ countries.</p><div class="chips"><span>Power BI</span><span>Power Query</span><span>CSV</span></div></div>
